topic: Q4 decode GEMV (qmm_vec.comp QMM_VEC_Q4_WORD) arithmetic parity with native Metal qmv
host: jwm1-linux, Apple M1 (G13G B1), Honeykrisp mesa-honeykrisp-omarchy 26.3.0.devel.hk6f6afc8-1, linux-asahi 7.1.6

native_arithmetic_found.source: metal/kernels/quantized.h qmv_impl (K % 512 != 0) / qmv_fast_impl (K % 512 == 0 and N % 8 == 0), load_vector, qdot, T=half U=float, built with -fno-fast-math
native_arithmetic_found.per_lane_block: sum = float accumulation of half-precision chain sums ((x0+x1)+x2)+x3 per quad; accum = source-order ((p0+p1)+p2)+p3 per quad, quads sequential; result += fma(scale, accum, sum * bias) (Metal contracts scale*accum + sum*bias into that fma, leaves sum*bias separate)
native_arithmetic_found.blocks: sequential over k, lane owns 8 (qmv) or 16 (qmv_fast) consecutive values
native_arithmetic_found.simd_sum_pairing: xor strides 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 (stride 1 first); (1,2,4,8,16) is the only one of the 120 stride permutations that reproduces every captured call35 projection (perm_search.py on native captures)
native_arithmetic_found.bit_exact_f32_evidence: native-m1max/native-probe-{512,896,1024,4864}-f32.json: at f32 dtype the model quads:fma_scale:xor_up reproduces every native output bit for bit in every stage (reduce, inputsum, dotonly, scaleonly, dot, full); every other modelled variant mismatches
native_arithmetic_found.f16_denormals: native-m1max/native-probe-896-f16-tiny.json: native preserves f16 denormals in the half quad chain

linux_before.root_cause: not the reduction: Honeykrisp NIR inexact algebraic rules (nir_opt_algebraic 'Reassociate add chains for more MAD/FMA-friendly code' and the late ffma reassociation) turned dot + (((p0+p1)+p2)+p3) into a sequential fma ladder and fused sum*bias into the accumulator add; candidate-061e645/probe-stages-896-f32*.json isolates it (reduce/inputsum/scaleonly exact, dotonly 50/256 and dot 583/1024 mismatching; sequential 0..7 association reproduces the GPU exactly, assoc_search)
linux_before.subgroupAdd: Honeykrisp float subgroupAdd already pairs lanes stride 1,2,4,8,16 (candidate-6b39daa/base-1257477-subgroupadd-reduce-probe.json: 0/1024 mismatches vs xor_up, 64 vs xor_down, 128 vs sequential); it is the unlowered AGX hardware reduction
